prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create a NEW textbook diagram illustrating three intervention sites for fairness in machine learning. The three supplied images are STYLE references only, particularly their solid main-color objects, pale containers and clear dark outlines. Do not copy their contents.
Portrait canvas 1024 by 1280, pure white, three balanced horizontal rows stacked vertically, usable at 112 mm width on a Chinese textbook page. Moderate compactness, generous but not excessive breathing room. Flat elegant 2D educational illustration, fine dark gray outlines, no gradients, no shadows. Each row has a blank heading band 60px high and a blank footer band 60px high reserved for real-font captions later. Artwork fills the middle of each row. Margins about 35px. NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO equations, NO pseudo-writing anywhere.
Palette exact: blue #7188A3 pale #E5EAF0; green #829C8B pale #E8EEE9; yellow #B4A16F pale #F1ECDD; red #A7787D pale #F0E5E6; purple #9588A5 pale #ECE8F0; dark ink #3B4252. Main objects use substantial SOLID main colors, pale fills only for containers; avoid a washed-out all-pastel appearance.
Top row DATA: left small illustration of a researcher with clipboard and several diverse people, middle rightward arrow, right orderly sample cards with person silhouettes, including one dashed blank card indicating an unknown label. Show supplementing underrepresented people and checking records, not balancing headcounts as a guarantee.
Middle row TRAINING: left illustrated analyst at laptop with small connected model nodes, rightward arrow, right two adjacent blank rectangular plaques about 180x90 px each, one blue edge and one green edge, for empirical risk objective and fairness constraint to be typeset later. Keep plaques blank, ample room for formulas. A simple small balance-scale icon can accompany them but no spurious graph data.
Bottom row DECISION: two genuinely INDEPENDENT input branches merge into a comparator. Upper branch: a die at left, branching to two small threshold cards in the center (blank cards with one vertical tick at differing positions), then converging into one selected-threshold card. Lower branch: separate blue score card at left directly feeding the comparator on right. Selected threshold enters comparator from above; score enters from left. Comparator outputs to a small green decision card at far right with simple check mark. No connection from the score card into the die or random choice: random threshold selection is independent of individual score. Keep branch topology uncluttered and straight, arrowheads unambiguous. Reserve blank spaces alongside die, threshold cards, score card, comparator, and decision card for short typography overlay. Arrange all bottom-row artwork between y=925 and y=1180. Make the diagram readable, aesthetically polished, suitable for an academic book. No overall title, no watermark, no decorative background.
edit_prompt: Edit the supplied textbook diagram, preserving ALL geometry, panel arrangement, people, cards and arrow topology exactly. Remove the visible paper grain/noise and ALL gradients: the background must be perfectly uniform pure white #FFFFFF, and every panel/card/icon region must have one perfectly uniform flat fill. Use ONLY canonical blue #7188A3/#E5EAF0, green #829C8B/#E8EEE9, yellow #B4A16F/#F1ECDD, red #A7787D/#F0E5E6, purple #9588A5/#ECE8F0, ink #3B4252. Skin may be a flat natural warm peach. Main clothes/nodes/arrows/silhouettes solid main colors; heading/footer bands pale colors; dark ink outlines. IMPORTANT remove the greater-than-or-equal symbol from the bottom comparator square, leaving it completely blank for real-font typesetting. Remove all tiny horizontal faux-writing lines from the person cards, leaving silhouettes and blank card interiors. Keep the score card blank except for its person silhouette at left. Keep dice dots, threshold ticks and the decision checkmark because these are pictorial objects. No text, numbers, mathematical glyphs, pseudo-writing, textures, shadows, gradients. Do not change locations or sizes. Make it look like crisp flat vector art rendered as PNG.
user_request: Model redraw of figure 13.4, balanced page layout and stronger canonical palette
postprocessing: Real font overlay only; all artwork and topology generated by model.
